output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of the target to a large value, also also known as a balance dump.
The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow where 'balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value' can cause an overflow and set it to a negative value, also also known as a bad debt.
The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow where 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value' can cause an overflow and set it to a negative value, also also known as a bad debt.
The 'freezeAccount' function allows the owner to lock others' accounts, aka bad access control, aka not following the smallest permission principle.
The 'ERC20Token' function is a typo of 'token' constructor, it has bad identifier, aka also known as constructor vulnerability.
